notes: Source: Kennesaw State University official Academic Maps (4-Year Suggested Program Map), https://public-apps.kennesaw.edu/academic-maps/programs/T0001101. Map label suffix "26" denotes the 2026-2027 catalog.
Prerequisites converted from KSU's boolean prerequisite expressions (AND/OR with minimum grades); minimum-grade qualifiers omitted; non-course requirements (null-code entries) omitted.

Choice slots (code null in source) carry the official option text in choice_note and parsed course options in options; prerequisite references to option courses not placed in-plan are listed in external_prereqs per the collection rule.

Program description (from official map): The B.S. with a major in Middle Grades Education is designed to prepare effective teachers for learners in the middle school (grades 4 through 8). It leads to grades 4-8 teacher certification in Georgia. Candidates prepare in two of the five middle grades curriculum areas (mathematics, science, social studies, language arts, or reading). Preparation in the two teaching fields selected is more in-depth than the content requirements of the program for early childhood educators, but less extensive and less specialized than the requirements of programs for secondary educators.
